description: Quality and context controls that protect AI meaning, timing, and traceability.

controls.name: Claim-Line Grain Check
controls.rule: One row per service line; claim_line_id is unique and (claim_id, line_number) is unique within a claim.
controls.what_goes_wrong: Duplicate rows or many-to-many joins change the declared grain.
controls.what_ai_receives: Repeated service lines and repeated claim context that look individually valid.
controls.possible_ai_impact: Inflated totals, duplicated evidence, or distorted utilization.
controls.control_response: Validate PK/FK and (claim_id, line_number) uniqueness; assert join cardinality; quarantine duplicates before the AI-ready layer.

controls.name: Amount Semantics Check
controls.rule: billed_amount is the total USD amount for the service line, not a per-unit amount.
controls.what_goes_wrong: An upstream source changes the unit meaning but keeps the same numeric field and type.
controls.what_ai_receives: A schema-valid amount with the wrong business unit or meaning.
controls.possible_ai_impact: Line cost can be under- or overstated, affecting summaries and review signals.
controls.control_response: Enforce the semantic contract and unit metadata; normalize before AI; never derive or reinterpret per-unit values silently; flag contract mismatches.

controls.name: Point-in-Time Context Check
controls.rule: service_date drives eligibility, plan, and policy selection.
controls.what_goes_wrong: A valid date is wrong for the service, or a current plan/policy is used instead of the as-of version.
controls.what_ai_receives: A schema-valid line paired with the wrong coverage or policy context.
controls.possible_ai_impact: Incorrect approve, deny, or escalate recommendation.
controls.control_response: Validate service_date against the parent claim window; perform temporal joins on effective/termination dates; preserve policy version and jurisdiction; flag no-match or multi-match cases.
